notes.title: Legends of Dawn Reborn Patch 2.77
notes.content:
Hi all!

The new Legends of Dawn Reborn patch is out and it brings the following:

[list]
[*]Changed loot/pickup window sound for dead bodies
[*]Changed loot/pickup window sound for killed creatures
[*]Changed loot/pickup window sound for plants/herbs
[/list]

As always, please keep us posted with your feedback regarding the patches!

Thank you!

Your,

Dreamatrix Team

notes.title: Patch 2.06 is live!
notes.content:
Hi all!

We have published another patch for Legends of Dawn Reborn! Here is what has been changed and what you will get:

[list]

[*]Bug with text not being correctly displayed in some panels is (hopefully) fixed. Panels in questions were Load Game, Save Game, Shop, Quest Log and Bestiary.
[/list]

[*]Wrong rendering of fog of war in Maps panel (it could  be replicated when you set map to be show at 1/3 scree resolution) is fixed.

[*]Display of NPCs and monsters markers in the minimap (top left corner of the screen) is fixed.

Please post your feedback regarding updates on 

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/403200/discussions/]Legends of Dawn Reborn discussion board[/url]

Thank you!

Your,
Dreamatrix Team
